runs.name: Aperam S.A.; Luxembourg, Euronext Amsterdam APAM, not an SEC registrant, the US line New York Registry Shares one to one (Citibank register); spun off from ArcelorMittal 2011-01-25; Universal Stainless & Alloy Products bought for $45.00 a share in cash 2025-01-23; the annual report names Outokumpu, Acerinox, Arvedi and three Chinese producers, none an SEC filer, Outokumpu read from its own reports as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **EUR 38.50** (APAM, Euronext Amsterdam, 2026-10-13, aggregator, flagged; APEMY USD 42.93, OTC, stale 2026-10-12, flagged). Shares **72,467,683** at 2026-09-30 (73,184,570 issued less 716,887 treasury, the company's share-capital page), checked against the Annual Report 2025 (72,341,663 outstanding at 2025-12-31, the difference plan deliveries); the Mittal family trust 40.33%; cap **EUR 2,790M**; net debt **EUR 993M** at 2026-06-30 (Q2 2026 release, leases inside debt). Sovereign **3.76%** (ECB AAA curve, 30-year spot, 2026-10-12; owner earnings in EUR). `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` return not an SEC filer; arithmetic by hand in the research folder. Documents read (no accessions exist): Annual Reports 2025 (published 2026-03-26), 2024, 2023, 2021, 2019 and 2017, taken as Wayback byte copies of the aperam.com files after aperam.com refused connections mid-run; the Q2 2026 release of 2026-07-30 via Investegate; the Half-Year Report 2026 and the 2018 annual report not obtained (2016 and 2017 stand in US dollars); Universal's 8-K (`0001193125-25-011290`) and DEFM14A (`0001193125-24-267249`); one figure cross-checked (2025 sales EUR 6,080M, statement against release) and a restatement found (2024 capex 152 to 139, bearer plants moved to biological assets). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's business, risk and management sections (the brief's departure), stated in the run file. Owner cash all-equity, operating cash less capex, biological assets and lease principal, 2018 to 2025 (EUR M): 107, 246, 192, 393, 329, 160, 122, 263; businesses bought 31 (ELG, 2021) and 415 (Universal, 2025). Balance sheets 2016 to 2025 read: inventory about a third of sales; borrowings EUR 1.3B after Universal; deferred tax assets 94 (2020) to 408 (2025), EUR 326M of tax benefits lifting 2023 to 2025 net income (446) above pre-tax income (120); capex below depreciation since 2024. Q1 IN (ten years of segment results; nickel dependence sent to Q2's cost test by the commodity paragraph). **Q2 OUT**: Stainless & Electrical Steel decides at 70.7% of 2021 to 2025 operating income (EUR 1,532M of 2,166M); segment margin 7.5% to 8.7% (2016 to 2018), 17.7% and 12.5% (2021, 2022), then (0.6)%, 1.9%, 0.5% (2023 to 2025); base price "depends on market supply and demand", overcapacity "stabilised at a high level", low nickel pig iron "prevented stainless steel prices from recovering", import pressure up in 2025, in the filer's words; the protection trade policy (Brazil "Well-protected", the EU safeguard expiring 2026-06-30 with a replacement proposed, anti-dumping duties, CBAM), no figure read showing a low-cost position; group pre-tax return on book capital about 11.8% over ten years (about 8% without 2021 and 2022) against Outokumpu about 5.4% (two early years from an aggregator, flagged), both near nothing 2023 to 2025. The analyst judged the cost position read from words and returns rather than costs, and so not TOO HARD (WORK). Q3 to Q12 not reached. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged:** Brazilian tax assessments including one of R$1.2B (EUR 202M); the Mittal family selling pro rata into the 2022 buyback; the deferred-tax recognitions in Luxembourg carrying reported earnings; Universal bought at about $535.7M enterprise value, 10.6 times adjusted EBITDA, its own decade showing operating cash about $57M against capex about $111M, Alloys & Specialties profit EUR 70M to 38M in its first year inside. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: cycle base trough to trough 2020 to 2025 (specific (a)), EUR 243M before purchases, 169M after; growth 7.38% cut to 6.70% sales growth by specific (f); all spending deducted (no maintenance split filed); range **EUR 67.12 to 131.50** a share all-equity at the sovereign (equity-only 75.99 to 136.69) against EUR 38.50; no case earns the floor at the price (EUR 1,975M and 3,225M against an enterprise value of 3,783M); fair **EUR 22.18 all-equity** (USD 24.81), **EUR 33.53 equity-only** (USD 37.51); literal window beside, no-growth EUR 69.19, with the literal decline as the bottom EUR 1.62. Contamination declared by the analyst: another company's commit subjects, untracked research-folder names in git status and general memory-index lines, none naming this company, not used. **Write-early broken, declared in the self-audit:** after the template commit (0523a72e) Step 0, Q1, Q2 and the computation were written in one pass and committed together (7fa09f58), the fetch failures having taken most of the session. Commits 0523a72e and 7fa09f58, two. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for APEMY, APAM or Aperam). Citations: the analyst's check passed (42 ids, 34 quoted fragments, no E-id); the dispatcher's `dispatcher_citation_check.py` 42 ids, no missing id, no E-id, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) the brief's competitor rule (rivals that file with the SEC) has no answer when every named rival files elsewhere, and the commodity paragraph does not say which filings count; (2) specific (a) assumes the previous cycle is in the earnings currency, silent on a reporting-currency change (2018 here), so the two euro years were used and confessed; (3) the cap in (f) uses the highest share of sales, which for an alloy-surcharge seller moves with nickel, not the business; (4) the commodity paragraph's TOO HARD (WORK) clause leaves open whether a cost position read from words and returns, rather than costs per tonne, counts as read. Could not get: the Half-Year Report 2026, the 2018 annual report, Acerinox's reports, any cost per tonne against a rival.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: Stainless & Electrical Steel decides (70.7% of 2021 to 2025 operating income), a stainless producer whose base price depends on market supply and demand under global overcapacity and cheap Asian nickel pig iron, protected by trade policy (Brazilian protection, the EU safeguard, CBAM) rather than cost; segment margin 17.7% and 12.5% at the 2021 to 2022 peak, then (0.6)%, 1.9%, 0.5%; ten-year pre-tax return on capital about 11.8% (about 8% without the peak) against Outokumpu about 5.4%, both near nothing 2023 to 2025. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: Brazilian tax assessments, deferred-tax recognitions carrying 2023 to 2025 earnings, Universal Stainless bought at 10.6 times adjusted EBITDA. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range EUR 67.12 to 131.50 at the sovereign against EUR 38.50, no case earning the floor, fair EUR 22.18 all-equity, EUR 33.53 equity-only. Write-early broken by the analyst, declared.
